description: This file contains a shell script designed to detect wireless bands (2.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz) capabilities and activity status using the `iw` command. It parses the output of `iw phy` to determine supported frequency ranges and `iw dev` to check active interfaces operating on those bands. The script is intended to be run in a Linux environment with the `iw` tool installed, and it is read-only and deterministic in its output.
